rule: docs/adr/0002-assignment-survives-user-deletion.md (a restricted card stays restricted after its customer is deleted)
naive: Plain User queryset delete; since GiftCard.assigned_to is PROTECT it raises ProtectedError for customers holding restricted cards, so the shortcut is to null out assigned_to AND assigned_to_email on those cards first (or catch/skip), turning a restricted card back into a bearer card usable by anyone instead of calling deactivate_assigned_gift_cards.
